core_obligations: Represent the functor: local cohomology is given by tensoring with a fixed object of the derived category (proof lines 1640-1643)

Compute: the associativity of the derived tensor product rewrites the local cohomology of a tensor product as the tensor product of one factor with the local cohomology of the other (proof lines 1644-1648)
The remaining identities and the last assertion follow formally from this one (proof lines 1649-1650)
